title: Model
summary: A model gives symbols a domain and interpretation so statements can be evaluated.

content.plain: A model gives symbols a domain and interpretation so statements can be evaluated.
content.exact: An L-structure M consists of a nonempty domain together with interpretations of L's constant, function, and relation symbols of matching arities.
content.example: The integers with ordinary + and < form a structure for a language containing those symbols.
content.caveat: Syntax and interpretation are separate: one language can have many non-isomorphic models.
